name: quantum-operations
description: Hardware-agnostic FTQC engineering with exact optimization, QEC architectures, proven qudits, and Q-CTRL Fire Opal real-hardware execution.

interface.longDescription: Skills for exact quantum optimization, QEC and FTQC architecture, proven qutrit/qudit implementations, verification and resource estimation, plus Q-CTRL Fire Opal execution for supported real hardware, error suppression, iterative workloads, expectations, QAOA, dynamics, and Monte Carlo.
defaultPrompt: Use Quantum Operations to audit this quantum implementation for logical-width, non-Clifford, QEC, runtime, and resource bottlenecks.
Use Quantum Operations to design an exact fault-tolerant implementation of this algorithm and verify each lowering stage.
Use Quantum Operations to compare circuit optimizations and report logical width, non-Clifford cost, depth, scheduling constraints, and physical-resource assumptions.
